items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: You see, I took my mama, bought the guitar for me for one dollar.

ctx.x: Oh, you never did tell us about that old man who you started to tell us. He had a guitar, the first guitar you ever saw him, patched up.

And that started me to play. You see, I took my mama, bought the guitar for me for one dollar. She said, my son likes music. I think he's going to make good because he's interested in music. So she said, someday I'm going to get him a guitar and let him work out on it. So he said, well, he can have this old, I'll let him have this old guitar here for one dollar. So she said, well, alright. She had the dollar and she gave him the dollar and he gave her the guitar. When they finished playing they left to the next…
And nobody helped you at all?
